info.title: PadMapper Rentals API (US and Canada apartments for rent)
info.description:
US and Canadian rental listings as JSON by city: rent range, beds, baths, address, amenities, pet policy, contact phone and a 0-100 lead score.

Sold on API.market: https://api.market/store/benthepythondev/padmapper-rentals (plans, free trial and API key). Call it through the API.market gateway with your API.market key in the x-api-market-key header.

post.description: Returns PadMapper rental listings in any US or Canadian city: rent range, beds and baths, address, neighbourhood, coordinates, property type, amenities, pet policy, availability date, contact phone and a lead score. Up to 20 results per request, as JSON.

locations.title: Locations
locations.description: One or more PadMapper city slugs, city then state or province (e.g. 'san-francisco-ca', 'new-york-ny', 'toronto-on'). Each is searched on its own with the filters below, and Max listings applies per location.

location.title: Location (single, older field)
location.description: One city slug, e.g. 'san-francisco-ca'. Kept so saved inputs keep working; it is searched together with Locations.

propertyType.title: Property type
propertyType.description: Type of rental to search for.

maxPrice.title: Max price ($/mo)
maxPrice.description: Maximum monthly rent. A request returns 20 rows at most.

maxListings.title: Max listings
maxListings.description: Maximum listings to return per location (with listing URLs: for the whole run).

maxPages.title: Result pages per search
maxPages.description: PadMapper serves 10 listings per result page. The default reads 20 pages, about 200 listings per search. Raise it together with Max listings to export a whole city, for example 1,000 pages for up to 10,000 listings.

includePhotos.title: Include photos
includePhotos.description: Include listing image IDs and count.

listingUrls.title: Listing/search URLs (advanced)
listingUrls.description: Optional: specific PadMapper search URLs to scrape instead of building from location.

201.description: The results, one object per row.

400.description: The request body does not fit the input fields. The message says which field.
